propositions: Rich-text encoding differs between Jira Cloud (ADF JSON documents) and Data Center (plain text / wiki markup), causing code duplication in map_fields_to_remote and related functions.

A RichTextCodec Protocol with four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) is needed to capture the distinct Cloud call paths that compose fit and normalize in different combinations.

AdfCodec must wrap adapters/jira/adf.py on the Cloud side, and WikiTextCodec must live in the shared jira_family layer, with the Protocol defined in the shared layer to maintain import contract constraints.

A single real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, accepting RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency; Cloud backend.py delegates to it instead of maintaining a second body.

WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 characters) with a marker ' … [truncated by reconciler]', matching ADF's existing truncation behavior so observable behavior is unchanged for Cloud (J1 pinned oracles).

The codec abstracts the transport layer (fit and normalize steps are separate from wire conversion) so callers like _fit_description and sanitize_description compose exactly the operations they use today without silent behavior changes.
